firmware.title: Cannon Fodder
firmware.author: Mikhail Matveev; Open Fodder
firmware.description: Cannon Fodder on Open Fodder, from the Amiga or PC data, with Amiga Paula sound. Needs the game data in /fodder.
firmware.controls: Mouse to move and fire, keyboard for menus. F12: settings, F5/F7: save/load.
